title: PWOL-style portfolio synthetic benchmark and unfitted stress path
author: Pengyi Peng
conventions: both benchmarks are hypothetical fee-free hold indices, not buyable instruments
shock window endpoints inclusive, one-indexed; both use identical observable session IDs
same fee and target-weight schedule as original; alternate 53.5/46.5 with 46.5/53.5 every 21 sessions
the original path was intentionally fitted in the earlier demo; no parameters of either benchmark or the stress path are calibrated
